newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, off new contract lows.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, off new contract lows.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower and just above new contract lows amid bear-spreading and hedge selling, traders said.

"The (December/March) spread was sort of a sloppy item all day. It traded between 12 and 12-1/2 cents but it closed at 11-1/4 cents," a trader said. "We did see better producer-type selling today that we haven't seen recently."

MGE spring wheat ended unchanged to 3-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 3-1/4 cents at $4.01-3/4. That was just 3/4-cent above the new Dec contract low of $4.01. March and September 1997 also set new contract lows.
Trade was sluggish. Wilson Trading bear-spread 600,000 March/Dec at 12-1/2 cents. LFG and Benson-Quinn each bull-spread 500,000 Dec/March at 12-1/2 cents. Atwood Peavey sold one million Dec bushels.
MGE barley futures did not trade and closed unchanged.
